title: Agent-native identity / login
human_answer_md:
**Identity / login** is Ric's home turf: credentials, passkeys, DIDs / verifiable credentials, and delegation so an agent can prove who it is acting for — without a human clicking through every consent screen.

**Honest status:** the identity directory category exists and is empty (`none_yet`). No invented providers. See [/directory/identity.json](/directory/identity.json).
